visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-opening hero with heading, intro and CTAs beside a feature photo
descriptions: White background; huge black uppercase H1 with sparkle icon, intro paragraph, primary filled and secondary outlined buttons on the left; rounded-corner photo on the right. Photo sits beside the text, not behind it.

contentPattern.structure: one row with the image (optional), one row with heading, intro paragraph and CTA links (or a single row: image cell | text cell)

usage.description: H1 'Orlando Welcomes You', intro paragraph, CTAs 'Plan Your Visit' and 'Chat With OPAL AI', photo to the right

reuseGuidance: Use when the hero photo sits beside the text. For a photo behind the text use hero.
